en.headline: Man injured after charger overheats in Tsz Ching Estate flat fire
en.dek: About 250 residents were evacuated from Ching On House in Tsz Wan Shan after a fire early Tuesday; a 70-year-old man was taken to hospital.
body: A fire broke out in a flat at Ching On House, Tsz Ching Estate in Tsz Wan Shan early on Tuesday morning, injuring one man and leading to the evacuation of about 250 residents.

Police received multiple reports around 6am that a unit was on fire. Some callers said people and cats were trapped inside. Firefighters and police attended and assisted those inside. Initial inquiries indicate that an external charger had overheated and caused the blaze.

The affected unit on the 24th floor housed a family of four. A 70-year-old man, the male head of the household, was injured and required oxygen before being taken to hospital. Heavy smoke and flames were seen coming from the unit. No other injuries have been reported.

zh.headline: 慈正邨正安樓單位充電器過熱起火 七旬男戶主受傷 約250人疏散
zh.dek: 慈雲山慈正邨正安樓24樓單位今早約6時起火，初步相信外置充電器過熱引起，七旬男戶主燒傷送院，約250名居民疏散。
body: 慈雲山慈正邨正安樓一個單位今早發生火警，一名男子受傷，約250名居民需要疏散。
警方今早約6時接獲多名住戶報案，指正安樓有單位起火，部分報案人稱單位內有人及貓隻被困。消防及警方到場救援。初步調查相信是單位外置充電器過熱引起火災。
起火單位位於24樓，住有一家四口。事件中70歲男戶主受傷，需戴氧氣面罩後送院治理。現場可見濃煙及火光從單位冒出。暫無其他傷者報告。
